**Review of head ead98b1d1: clean.** I read the whole diff (5 files, 32 insertions, 7 deletions). The agent that wrote the change did not write this review.

- `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`: the step limit of "Batch gate tier" is 75 (was 45), and "Gate summary" tests `mins -ge 74` (was 44). The comment text agrees. No trigger, no runner label and no job limit changed.
- `xtask/tests/post_merge_stall.rs`: the pin is 75. Run by the author on this head: `cargo test -p xtask --test post_merge_stall`, 1 passed.
- `AGENTS.md` ("Runner stops") and the `runners` skill name 75 minutes.
- `docs/decisions/3535-post-merge-step-limit.md` records the decision in the format of the README.
- No pin of the old numbers for this step is left (`git grep`; `release.yml:449` is a different workflow).

This is the exact change that the maintainer named: "Maintainer decision: step limit 75 min (owner, question dialog 2026-11-22)" (recorded on #3535). It is a CI and process PR: it merges when it is reviewed. No heavy lane applies. Class: no refresh. I flag it ready and merge it now. The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows.

Not exercised: the workflow did not run with the new limit. The next push to `main` is its first run.
